schemaMarkup.reviewBody: Love this office so much! I’ve been going here since I was a kid. I moved an hour away and tried a new dentist, but then came right back. They’re always so nice, and my teeth always feel clean after my visit!
Brenda was so helpful. She reached out to another of their clinics just to make sure I was able to be treated as quickly as possible. So grateful for the service she provided.

I took my daughter here today after dealing with another pediatric dentist who was unable to treat my daughter due to her high anxiety, and WOW, it was a difference of night and day. They are amazing. They were so good with my daughter that they were able to build rapport and make her feel relaxed. I am so happy and wish I had taken my kids here before. I highly recommend this pediatric dentistry for their professionalism and the care they provide.
My appointment at Riccobene Assoc. Family Dentistry was extremely good today. Everyone was very friendly, caring, helpful, and professional, and much more. I was seen quickly and then on my way home.

The team they have working together here is the best!! They always make you feel right at home and super comfortable. It makes going to the dentist easy for my kids, because we always get smiles and kindness from their team 😊

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What services does the Selma, NC, dentist's office provide?

We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!

Do you offer pediatric dental care for children in Selma, NC?

Absolutely. We recognize the importance of starting dental care as early as possible and make sure to provide kids and families with pediatric dental care comfortably and comprehensively, as they deserve.

What cosmetic dental options are available at Selma, NC, Riccobene?

We understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Is emergency same-day dental care available in Selma, NC?

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Do you offer dental implants or restorative solutions in Selma, NC?

Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including dental implants.

How often should I schedule dental checkups in Selma, NC?

We recommend scheduling dental checkups every six months, though if your needs require more frequent visits, our expert team will provide you with the care you deserve.

Are payment plans or affordable options available for Selma, NC, patients?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

Is sedation or nitrous oxide offered for anxious patients?

We offer a variety of sedation dentistry options. You can choose from Nitrous Oxide, IV Sedation, and Local Anesthesia for your comfort.

Do you perform oral cancer screenings at Selma, NC?

Yes, we offer oral cancer screenings. Early cancer detection is critical for proper treatment and recovery. Your health is our priority.
